shortDescription: Adds or Sets auto logon registry keys.

options.name: logon_count
options.description: The number of times to do an automatic logon. This count is deremented by Windows everytime an automatic logon is performed. Once the count reaches C(0) then the automatic logon process is disabled.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to be used for automatic login. Must be set when C(state=present). Value of this input will be used as password for I(username). While this value is encrypted by LSA it is decryptable to any user who is an Administrator on the remote host.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the registry key should be C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: username
options.description: Username to login automatically. Must be set when C(state=present). This can be the Netlogon or UPN of a domain account and is automatically parsed to the C(DefaultUserName) and C(DefaultDomainName) registry properties.
